title: Vintage Print Top & Black Shorts
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy copper-red hair pulled into a loose bun wears round wire glasses and a black choker. She wears a fitted pink vintage-print long-sleeve top with black contrast sleeves and a crew neckline. Black low-rise cargo shorts sit under a studded black belt, with white ribbed socks and black platform boots. Her expression is calm and direct. A soft blue gradient backdrop with even light. Palette of blush pink, black, and soft sky blue. Playful and retro, in the style of a Y2K streetwear catalog.
workingNotes:
